# Category controller should not hardcode a layout tpl

The front Category controller call 'layouts/layout-full-width.tpl' here:
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/5005657ed11f15e81c2d8cb5e4a855acd19213e1/controllers/front/listing/CategoryController.php#L165

So, if the theme doesn't have this layout this line raise a SmartyException if the category is inactive or unauthorized

## Attendu
no exception

## Étapes
- Delete or rename layouts/layout-full-width.tpl in your theme
- Change the default layout un theme.yml to another layout (layout-left-column by example)
- Remove the full layout in available_layouts section of the theme.yml
- Reset the theme in the bo (in debug mode)
- Back Office : Choose a category
- Front Office : Go to this category page in front
- Back Office : Disable this category 
- Front Office : Reload this category page in front
